headline: Vikram Solar Limited enters Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process
sum: Vikram Solar Limited, a solar panel manufacturer, has been admitted into Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process (CIRP) under the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, 2016. The company informed NSE of the development via formal exchange intimation.
detail: Vikram Solar Limited, a renewable energy equipment manufacturer, has entered into CIRP following a petition (by creditor or debtor self-admission). The company intimated NSE of the insolvency status via formal disclosure on 29 June 2026. Under IBC 2016, the company is now subject to a maximum 180-day resolution period (extendable by 90 days) during which a Resolution Professional (RP) will manage operations and oversee creditor-led restructuring or asset realisation. The admission order determines the insolvency estate and triggers suspension of promoter actions, freezing of related-party transactions, and commencement of claims process.
